floors.clue: A deep fissure or rift in the earth, rock, or another surface.
A steep high rock face, especially one at the edge of the sea.
A large cave, especially one that is dark and underground.
A deep, narrow gorge with steep sides carved by water.
A mountain or hill having a crater through which lava and gas erupt.
A large volcanic crater, typically one formed by a major eruption.
A deep open crack, especially one in a glacier or ice sheet.
A large design or motif produced on the ground by enduring rocks or soil.
A structure or arrangement of rocks or landforms resulting from natural processes.
Large prehistoric stones used to construct monuments or structures.
